name: Meet-ups
description: Speakers and panels. Someone shows you what they built and how, then we all argue about it over a drink.

name: Co-building sessions
description: Bring your own project and work on it alongside other people doing the same. Quiet focus, loud breaks.

name: Workshops
description: Hands-on learning sessions. Laptops open, something working by the end.

name: Networking
description: Cafe catch-ups and Friday night drinks. No agenda, no slides.

name: Pop-ups
description: Someone interesting is in town, or something just happened that we all need to talk about. Short notice, worth it.
